subject: POC plan & timeline - ZetaCorp (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Hill <jordan.hill@zetacorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zetacorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC follow-up: success criteria & proposed timeline

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Great conversation today — thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can get the POC moving: 

Recap / success criteria you mentioned:
- Latency: p95 inference latency below 200ms for your 2k token average prompt
- Quality: parity or better compared to current in-house baseline for the 5 eval prompts we discussed (target >=95% on rubric)
- Cost: target unit cost that keeps 1M-token monthly spend under your internal budget threshold (you mentioned $X as a reference)
- Security/compliance: Redwood must provide SOC 2 summary and standard audit evidence for the trial environment

Proposed POC scope & timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (setup, prep): account provisioning, API keys, sample dataset transfer (Mar 8–12) — Redwood owner: Marcus Lin
- Week 1 (integration): ingest prompts, run baseline tests, iterate on prompt templates (Mar 15–19)
- Weeks 2–3 (evaluation): run full eval suite, monitor latency/cost, iterate on batching/quantization config (Mar 22–Apr 2)
- Week 4 (final readout): results review, regression checks, handoff + next steps (Apr 5–9)

Proposed cadence: 30-min weekly check-ins (Wednesdays 10:00am PT), and ad-hoc deep dives as needed.

Attachments: I put a first-pass POC plan in the Drive and attached a v1 doc to this email (zetacorp-poc-plan-v1.docx).

Next steps / asks:
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or add any missing items.
2) Confirm the proposed kickoff week (we're targeting Mar 8).
3) Security: please share the contact for any SOC2/infosec questionnaire so we can loop them in.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to tweak scope.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: zetacorp-poc-plan-v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 42KB)

From: Jordan Hill <jordan.hill@zetacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zetacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: success criteria & proposed timeline

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Latency: p95 <200ms is correct and critical for our UX. We'll provide representative traffic later today.
- Quality: the 5 eval prompts are good. We also want to include 3 short multi-turn flows (customer support scenarios) as part of the regression checks.
- Cost: we don't need exact pricing right now but please include estimated token cost for the test runs so we can sanity-check vs budget.
- Security: I'll route SOC2 intake to our security contact (Priya copied).

Kickoff week: Mar 8 is nominally OK for us. Can we do a kickoff on Tue Mar 9 at 10:00am PT instead of Monday? That gives our infra team a day to prep.

Also to confirm owners: Marcus for Redwood infra/setup, Marissa for program/PM, Jordan is our exec sponsor, Priya is technical/security lead.

I'll review the attached plan and give feedback by EOD Monday.

-Jordan
Director, Product Ops | ZetaCorp
jordan.hill@zetacorp.com

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Hill <jordan.hill@zetacorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zetacorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC follow-up: success criteria & proposed timeline

Thanks Jordan — Tue Mar 9 at 10:00am PT works for us. I've updated the timeline below to reflect the kickoff on Mar 9 and included owners. Please review and confirm: 

Updated timeline (dates):
- Kickoff: Tue Mar 9 — introductions, access/keys, confirm evaluation datasets (30–45m)
- Week 1 (Mar 9–13): provisioning + baseline runs (Marcus)
- Week 2 (Mar 16–20): prompt integration + multi-turn flows (Marcus + Priya)
- Week 3 (Mar 23–27): evaluation run, latency/cost tuning (Marcus)
- Week 4 (Mar 30–Apr 3): final readout prep (Marissa) and presentation to your execs (Apr 6 optional)

Cadence: Weekly 30-min syncs on Wednesdays at 10:00am PT starting Mar 11. I'll send the recurring invite after you confirm.

Deliverables we will provide during the POC:
- Shared Drive folder with test artifacts and run results
- Weekly status notes and token/cost burn report
- Final readout deck and recommended config for production rollout

Related links: HubSpot deal + shared Drive folder included below — I'll also upload the SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) to the Drive and copy Priya when it's available.

If any additional stakeholders need to be looped in (legal, procurement), let me know and I'll add them to invites/doc access.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
Marissa

Marissa / Jordan —

Confirming Tue Mar 9 at 10:00am PT for kickoff. I've asked our security team to review Redwood's SOC2 summary; they may have a short questionnaire. Security contact is security@zetacorp.com.

A couple of asks from our side before kickoff:
- Please ensure the test environment has IP allowlisting options and an audit log export for the trial window.
- Share an estimated token cost for a 2-week full eval (sample size ~250k tokens) so procurement can provision a short-term purchase order.

Jordan — we'll block the time on our calendar. Marcus — I'll send a short list of infra access items we'll need (S3 sample bucket credentials, API endpoint allowlist).

Thanks —
Priya Singh

priya.singh@zetacorp.com
